eventDetail.scope: The IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference (RE) is the premier international forum for research and practice in requirements engineering: the elicitation, analysis, specification, validation, prioritisation, management and evolution of requirements for software-intensive systems. It covers foundations and methods, requirements for safety-critical, self-adaptive and AI-based systems, AI and data-driven support for requirements work, and the legal, ethical, security and sustainability concerns shaping them.
